title: The R-02 pin is not tested by behaviour at its call site
evidence: Mutant: replace 'binding.verify(root, line, lines, canonical_line, expected_top=pinned_top)' by the same call without expected_top. All 160 module tests pass. With the mutant, a nested .git directory and a gitdir: file at the ledger root both give APPLIED, bound_by 2 in the real layout. The test calls binding.verify directly with a synthetic root and then asserts on the source text of apply_ledger (inspect.getsource).
consequence: A later edit can drop the wiring and re-open R-02 without any test failing.
required_correction: Add a behavioural test in the real layout (a repository whose top holds legal_knowledge/audit_work/AUTH-LEDGER with a planted .git directory and a gitdir: file), or make the package root injectable so the test can run apply_ledger with a pinned root.

location: PKG = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]; apply_ledger pinned_top; verify root resolve
title: A symlinked package directory diverts verification to another repository
evidence: Audited repository: two commits, no merge, version 0 only; legal_knowledge/audit_work/AUTH-LEDGER then committed as a symlink to the same path inside a second full repository X that holds a proper merge and BIND line. reader.effective_state() imported through the symlinked tools path returns [('APPLIED', 2)]; audited repository git status is empty. All paths are resolved, so PKG, the pinned top and the git top all lie in X.
consequence: A verifier who runs the tool by its path inside the audited working copy verifies another history. Limits: the symlink must be committed (mode 120000, visible in the tree and in a PR diff) or git status is dirty; the target must exist on the verifier's machine; a fresh clone leaves it dangling. Within the stated trust assumption, which does not name symlinks.
required_correction: Fail closed when the package path as invoked contains a symlink (compare os.path.abspath(__file__) with os.path.realpath(__file__)), or when the manifest path is not a regular tracked file under the repository top; otherwise name symlinked package directories in the trust-assumption paragraph of APPROVAL_CONTROLS.md.

title: Only the committed package root is pinned; the default is unpinned
evidence: scratchpad/rr3/scripts/bind4.py N3 (synthetic ledger root) still returns APPLIED, bound_by 2 with a nested .git directory and with a gitdir: file. apply_ledger passes a pin only when root resolves to PKG. The command-line tool always uses PKG.
consequence: A library caller that verifies a ledger at another root gets no nested-.git protection. Documented as 'for the committed ledger'.
required_correction: Optional: require expected_top explicitly (no default), so each caller states its choice.

title: Forged commit objects under a genuine id are rejected only as a side effect of git's hash check
evidence: Forged loose object in an alternate (genuine removed), mislabelled packed object in the main store and in an alternate: 'rev-list --parents -n 1' returns 2 parents and the two-parent check passes; 'merge-base --is-ancestor <merge> HEAD' then fails with 'error: hash mismatch', rc 128, reported as 'merge_commit is not in the history of the checked-out HEAD'. git fsck reports the pack.
consequence: Rejection depends on git 2.43.0 behaviour, not on a stated control; the error message does not say why.
required_correction: Optional: re-hash the commit objects named in the BIND line (git cat-file commit | git hash-object -t commit --stdin) and fail with a specific message; note the git version tested.

title: Further look-alike characters and two court-path forms are still accepted
evidence: Accepted for a government class: /%CC%81a.pdf (leading combining mark, named in R-05 evidence but not in its required correction), a%E2%88%96b (U+2216), a%E2%A7%B5b (U+29F5), a%E2%A7%B9b (U+29F9), a%E2%95%B1b (U+2571), a%E2%9F%8Bb (U+27CB), a%E3%80%B3b (U+3033). Accepted for the court class: https://evil.sci.gov.in/jonew/judis/1.pdf and https://api.sci.gov.in/supremecourt/2011/1/-.pdf. All 74 committed URLs and all 32 draft locators decode to printable ASCII (the only escapes are %20 and %22).
consequence: A block list of look-alikes is open-ended. No committed or draft locator is affected.
reproduction: from AUTH-LEDGER/tools, call strength.locator_problem(url, 'PRIMARY_GAZETTE_GOVERNMENT_HOSTED_SCAN') or with 'PRIMARY_OFFICIAL_COURT_COPY' for each URL listed; an empty string means accepted
required_correction: Optional: require decoded path characters to be printable ASCII (rejects none of the committed or draft locators), or record the accepted set in the urlcheck docstring; decide the sci.gov.in host list with the owner.
